movie.title: Satluj
movie.overview: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Driven by a personal quest to find his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra exposes a state-sponsored conspiracy involving thousands of extrajudicial killings and forced disappearances in Punjab.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra sets out to locate his missing aunt, he uncovers a vast and harrowing conspiracy embedded deep within the police and state authorities. Operating during the darkest days of Punjab's insurgency, he works tirelessly to document thousands of secret cremations and unlawful detentions. Facing immense pressure and life-threatening danger from a corrupt system, Khalra remains steadfast in his determination to give voice to the victims. His heroic crusade highlights the profound toll of state violence and the unyielding quest for truth and justice.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the violent backdrop of Punjab's insurgency period, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra begins a journey that transforms into a monumental fight for justice. What starts as a desperate search for his missing aunt quickly leads him to uncover evidence of systematic state-sponsored violence. Digging into official records and municipal data, Khalra exposes how security forces illegally detained, killed, and secretly cremated thousands of individuals under the guise of counter-insurgency operations. As he gathers meticulous proof of these forced disappearances, he confronts a deeply broken judicial and administrative system determined to suppress the truth. Despite escalating threats, surveillance, and immense personal risk, Khalra refuses to back down from presenting his findings to the international community. His courage shines a light on the tragic loss suffered by thousands of families seeking closure for their vanished loved ones. By meticulously linking government actions to illegal body disposals at local cremation grounds, he presents undeniable evidence of severe human rights violations. Ultimately, Khalra's persistent advocacy forces a powerful system to answer for its atrocities, creating a lasting legacy of resistance against state oppression. His story stands as a sobering and vital reflection on the moral obligation to fight for human dignity and truth, regardless of the personal cost.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Satluj tells the powerful story of human rights advocate Jaswant Singh Khalra during one of the most turbulent periods in Punjab's history. Sparked by a personal effort to find his missing aunt, Khalra stumbles upon terrifying evidence indicating that thousands of citizens have vanished at the hands of state security forces during counter-insurgency campaigns. Undeterred by the immense power of a corrupt system, he meticulously uncovers municipal records of unidentified cremations, revealing a widespread pattern of extrajudicial killings and enforced disappearances. As Khalra works to bring international awareness to these atrocities and provide answers to desperate families, he faces mounting danger from the very authorities he aims to expose. The narrative delivers an inspiring and emotionally charged exploration of courage, moral responsibility, and the relentless pursuit of truth in the face of systemic power.

story_structure.climax: The struggle reaches its most dangerous peak as the authorities, desperate to suppress the revelations, target Khalra directly to prevent the truth from fully reaching the public eye.
story_structure.conflict: As Khalra investigates, he uncovers evidence of a massive, systemic conspiracy involving thousands of untraceable extrajudicial killings and illegal cremations carried out by state authorities.
story_structure.resolution: Khalra's brave stand transforms his investigation into a monumental historical record, inspiring ongoing human rights advocacy and ensuring the victims' stories cannot be erased.
story_structure.introduction: Human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra begins a personal quest when his missing aunt disappears during the height of Punjab's insurgency, introducing the broader state of fear and lawlessness.
story_structure.risingAction: Determined to bring the truth to light, Khalra gathers meticulous records, encounters immense institutional resistance, faces constant threats, and works tirelessly to expose the cover-up locally and internationally.
